turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Our hallway rug is disgusting. Muddy boots, the dog, my kids, all of it.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hallways take a beating. Would you go for a flat woven one you can throw in the washing machine, or something thicker that's nicer underfoot?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I'll need eighteen seconds to think. Ask me again after that.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: So, machine washable flat rug, or the cosy thick kind?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Washable, no question. Have you met my kids?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Ha, fair. Get a non slip pad under it too, flat rugs slide around on hard floors.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Oh, also, There's a field full of cows on the footpath I want to use. Am I being silly to be scared?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Not silly at all. Cows are usually calm, but mothers with calves can get protective.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Oh great. So what do I do?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Walk calmly around the edge of the herd rather than through the middle, and don't get between a cow and her calf.
